It may not have been added to the vendor yet.{{#if: {{NAMESPACE}}||[[Category:Pages with empty semantic mediawiki query results]]}}
}} == Description == Generates a table of vendors selling the item. Format using {{tl|sold by header}} and {{tl|sold by result format}}. == Usage == 
{{sold by}}
{{sold by||showSection=}}
{{sold by|id=}}
=== Parameters === ;Unnamed parameter 1 : Optional. Query term. Defaults to {{PAGENAME}}. ;id : Optional. Query term. Can be used instead of ''unnamed parameter 1''. ;showSection : Optional. ''' True''' or '''False''', default False. Show the section of the vendor the item is in. Redundant for most tables. ;showCostText : Optional. ''' True''' or '''False''', default False. Shows the text for the cost of each item in addition to the icon. ;include historical vendors : Optional. By default, historical vendors are shown in vendor lists generated by this template. Setting this parameter equal to "n" will remove historical vendors from the results. ;limit : Optional. Maximum number of results to display. Defaults to 100. === Examples === 
{{sold by|Cirque of Arah}}
{{sold by|Cirque of Arah}} 
{{sold by|Mystic Forge Stone}}
{{sold by|Mystic Forge Stone}} 
{{sold by|Debbie's Cake}}
{{sold by|Debbie's Cake}}
